newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Finance Trust & Inv to set $85 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Finance Trust & Inv to set $85 mln loan.

text.p: Guangdong Finance Trust and Investment Co has mandated Societe Generale Asia and Hong Kong Bank China Services to arrange a US$85 million loan facility, bankers said.
Security is provided through a letter of comfort issued by the Guangdong Provincial Finance Bureau.
They said the facility has a final maturity of five years. It has an average life of 3.9 years and pays an interest margin of 100 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Proceeds are to be used for industrial projects in Guangdong province in China.
